battle.name: 拉齊克戰爭
battle.brief: 拉齊克戰爭（541至562年）係拜占庭帝國同薩珊波斯為爭奪黑海東岸拉齊卡打嘅二十一條年邊境戰爭。羅馬靠海運同沿岸堡壘線同波斯嘅重騎兵對峙，列陣重步兵以大盾重疊成嘅盾牆頂住騎兵衝鋒，卡牌上嘅希臘重步兵正係呢種方陣血統喺帝國軍中嘅原型。

kit.name: 希臘重步兵
kit.history: 方陣的重心不是個人，是互相遮蔽。盾牌接在一起時，一支軍隊的正面比一個人結實。

countries: 拉齊克戰爭（541至562年）係拜占庭帝國同薩珊波斯為爭奪黑海東岸嘅拉齊卡（古科爾喀斯，今喬治亞西部）而打嘅二十一條年邊境戰爭。交戰方表面上只有兩個帝國，但拉齊卡本國係兩者之間嘅緩衝王國，不斷改變效忠對象。拜占庭方面，皇帝查士丁尼一世坐鎮君士坦丁堡，戰區最高指揮係亞美尼亞軍區軍事總監（magister militum per Armeniam），約翰·齊布斯係首任，其後有馬丁、貝薩斯、多明努斯與達吉斯提俄斯等將領輪替；帝國野戰軍主力為禁軍與御林軍（scholae）以及新整編嘅軍區民兵，另有色雷斯人、阿蘭人、塞伯爾人、扎尼人（Tzani）等部族傭兵，同拉齊卡人、阿巴茲吉亞沿海諸部作附庸部隊參戰。海運由黑海艦隊負責，糧秣自君士坦丁堡與特拉比松經海路送抵塞巴斯托波利斯同法西斯。薩珊方面，國王科斯勞一世坐鎮泰西封，總攬全局嘅係波斯軍區總督同各路封主（feudatory）軍隊，草原出身嘅薩珊重騎兵（spah）同重甲騎兵（cataphract）為突擊主力，步兵以大盾作掩體，另備象隊攻城；將領有拉哈扎德、米赫蘭·米赫羅耶、伊扎德古什asp同納霍拉干。伊比利亞（喬治亞東部）同亞美尼亞兩地嘅附庸軍隊先屬波斯，後因瓦罕率阿美尼亞系貴族倒戈而改為拜占庭盟友；拉齊卡國王古巴澤二世喺541年倒向波斯、548年又倒向拜占庭，令雙方喺同一片海岸線上反覆爭奪同一批堡壘。
countriesEn: The Lazic War (541-562) was a twenty-one-year frontier war fought between the Byzantine Empire and the Sasanian Empire for control of Lazica, the ancient Colchis on the eastern shore of the Black Sea, in what is now western Georgia. On the surface there were only two great powers, but between them sat the Lazic kingdom itself, a buffer realm that repeatedly switched its allegiance. On the Byzantine side the emperor Justinian I remained at Constantinople and delegated the theatre to the magister militum per Armeniam, the military governor of Armenia: John Tzibus was the first of them, and after him Martin, Bessas, Domninus and Dagisthaeus rotated through the command. The field armies drew their heavy infantry from the scholae palatinae and from the newly reorganised thematic levies, supplemented by Thracians, Alans, Sabirs, the mountain Tzani, and the Lazi and Abasgians of the coast as subject auxiliaries. The Black Sea fleet carried grain and wine from Constantinople and Trebizond to Sebastopolis and Phasis. On the Sasanian side King Khosrow I ruled from Ctesiphon and directed everything through the satraps of the frontier and the contingents of his feudatory princes; the steppe-born spah and the armoured cataphracts formed the striking arm, infantry with the large wicker sipa shield covered the advance, and war elephants supported the sieges. The commanders included Rhahzadh, Mihr-Mihroe, Izadgushasp and Nachoragan. The levies of Iberia and Armenia were Persian at first and became Byzantine allies after the Armenian prince Vahan defected; King Gubazes II of Lazica leaned to Persia in 541 and to Byzantium in 548, so that the two empires fought over the same chain of fortresses along the same shore.
people: 拉齊克戰爭嘅關鍵人物集中喺兩位君主、兩位拉齊卡國王同一批會改變戰局嘅將領。拜占庭皇帝查士丁尼一世（527至565年喺位）將拉齊卡視為帝國東北方嘅屏障，佢不斷派援軍、駁回前線將領過度嘅請款，又喺545年西線議和之後將注意力轉回高加索，親自批准同波斯談判，最終喺562年簽訂五十年和約。薩珊王科斯勞一世（531至579年在位）策動拉齊卡叛亂以削弱拜占庭喺黑海東岸嘅立足點，並趁羅馬注意力轉向意大利同北非時親自領兵入拉齊卡；佢死後由霍爾米茲二世繼位，於是完成議和。拉齊卡國王古巴澤二世喺541年邀波斯人入援、548年又起兵驅走波斯人，係兩邊爭奪嘅樞紐。拜占庭將領中，貝利撒留（Belisarius）喺542年奉召回東方，主導拉齊卡戰區嘅攻勢並守住佩特拉堡壘；約翰·齊布斯為拉齊卡總督，其後喺戰鬥中陣亡；多明努斯同貝薩斯帶領援軍收復失地；亞美尼亞人瓦罕（Wahman，又譯瓦漢）本係薩珊朝廷中嘅阿美尼亞裔貴族，549至550年間倒向拜占庭，551年於伊比利亞擊敗米赫蘭·米赫羅耶，令波斯喺高加索嘅側翼作戰崩解。最後要提普羅科匹烏斯：《戰史》第五至第八卷係呢場戰爭最完整嘅一手記錄，佢嘅敘述亦係後世判斷勝負嘅主要依據。
peopleEn: The decisive personalities of the Lazic War were concentrated in two monarchs, two kings of Lazica, and a handful of generals who could turn the campaign either way. The Byzantine emperor Justinian I (r. 527-565) treated Lazica as the shield of the empire's north-eastern flank: he kept feeding reinforcements to the front, refused his generals' requests for more money and men, and after the western peace of 545 turned his attention back to the Caucasus, personally authorising the negotiations with Persia that finally produced the fifty-year peace in 562. The Sasanian king Khosrow I (r. 531-579) stirred up the revolt in Lazica in order to weaken the Byzantine foothold on the eastern Black Sea, and marched into Lazica in person while Roman attention was fixed on Italy and North Africa; after his death his son Hormizd II succeeded him and carried the negotiations through. King Gubazes II of Lazica, who invited the Persians in in 541 and then rose to drive them out in 548, was the pivot both sides pulled on. Among the Byzantine commanders, Belisarius was recalled to the East in 542, directed the offensive in the Lazic theatre and held the fortress of Petra; John Tzibus, the Roman governor of the region, was killed in action; Domninus and Bessas led the relieving forces that recovered lost ground; and Vahan (Wahman), an Armenian of noble birth at the Sasanian court, defected to Byzantium between 549 and 550 and defeated Mihr-Mihroe in Iberia in 551, which shattered the Persian flank operations in the Caucasus. Finally there is Procopius: Books V to VIII of his Wars are the fullest surviving account of the campaign, and his narrative is the main basis on which later generations judged who had won.
kits: 呢場戰爭卡片上嘅兵器係希臘重步兵（hoplite），佢喺541年之後嘅帝國軍隊裡已經唔係制式裝備，卻以戰術原型嘅身份貫穿全場。拜占庭方面：野戰步兵以御林軍（scholae）同軍區民兵為主，重步兵沿用希臘方陣傳統——大圓盾（thureos）重疊成盾牆、長矛平舉成密集矛列，構成正面最堅硬嘅部分；弓手放喺盾牆之前施放箭雨，盾牆之後跟隨輕裝步兵與投射兵器。拉齊卡與阿巴茲吉亞嘅地方部隊多由希臘殖民城市（米利都系）後裔組成，保留最原始嘅重步兵方陣傳統，成為羅馬指揮官喺山區與海岸線上常用嘅密集盾列骨幹。薩珊方面：步兵主力係持大藤盾（sipa）嘅薩珊盾兵，輔以可用於騎射亦可步射嘅複合弓，弓手列於重騎兵之前射擊；重甲騎兵（cataphract）人馬皆披鎖子甲或魚鱗甲，持長矛與彎刀，衝鋒前先以弓手擾亂敵陣。攻城與野戰輔助裝備包括投石機、弩砲（cheiroballistra）與攻城塔，以及波斯象隊；兩軍的運輸依靠馬匹、驢騾馱運、海運船隻同山區人力背扛。糧秣方面，羅馬靠黑海船隊自君士坦丁堡與特拉比松運米麥、油酒到塞巴斯托波利斯與法西斯卸貨，波斯則自美索不達米亞經亞美尼亞同扎尼的山道輸送，兩邊嘅補給線都受制於山脈與冬季。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is the Greek hoplite. By 541 it was no longer a standard piece of equipment in the imperial army, yet it runs through the whole campaign as a tactical archetype. On the Byzantine side the field infantry was drawn from the scholae palatinae and the thematic levies, and the heavy infantry kept the Greek phalanx tradition: large round shields (thureoi) overlapped into a wall, spears levelled into a dense file, and this was the hardest part of the front. Shooters stood in front of the shield wall and loosed volleys, with light infantry and missile troops following behind. The local contingents of Lazica and Abasgia were largely descended from the Greek colonial towns of the Milesian foundation and preserved the oldest heavy-infantry phalanx tradition, and they became the backbone of the dense shield formations that Roman commanders used in the mountains and along the coast. On the Sasanian side the infantry line rested on shield-bearers with the large wicker sipa, supported by composite bows that could be used from the saddle or on foot, with archers posted ahead of the cavalry; the cataphracts and their horses were covered in mail or scale, carried lance and scimitar, and charged after the archers had disordered the enemy. The siege and field train included stone-throwers, cheiroballistae, siege towers and Persian elephants; movement depended on horses, mules and donkeys, seagoing transports and human porters in the hills. For supply, the Byzantines ran grain, wine and oil to Sebastopolis and Phasis by the Black Sea fleet from Constantinople and Trebizond, while Persia moved its own provisions from Mesopotamia by the mountain tracks through Armenia and the Tzan, and the supply lines of both sides were at the mercy of the ranges and of winter.
tactics: 拉齊卡嘅地形決定咗兩軍嘅打法：黑海沿岸公路由佩特拉（喺今巴統以北嘅奇希茲吉里一帶）通往法西斯（波提），再伸入里奧尼河谷同山區，全程百餘公里，沿線堡壘相接；山脊、峽谷同密林令大隊人馬難以展開，天然利於防守方。拜占庭以海路供應、沿海岸線據守嘅堡壘加海運體系，同波斯嘅騎兵加攻城體系正面對撞：波斯軍避免強攻設防完善嘅城塞，集中攻擊佩特拉等外圍要點，圍而不克就轉而劫掠鄉村、破壞田園，切斷羅馬嘅徵召與稅收；羅馬野戰軍則以密集盾列頂住重騎兵衝鋒，弓手先行齊射，然後以少量騎兵側擊，迫敵迂迴。亞美尼亞人瓦罕擅長利用伊比利亞嘅山地與隘口，551年擊敗米赫蘭靠嘅就係選擇地形同出其不意；543年安格隆之敗則顯示羅馬偵察過度輕敵、以小隊深入山區會被波斯騎兵包圍。冬季係關鍵：波斯方常喺開春雪融時進攻，羅馬方則利用雨季與海運維持城塞；拉齊克與扎尼嘅山地民兵熟悉小徑，專門襲擊波斯糧隊與哨所。整體而言，雙方都明白黑海沿岸嘅堡壘線同山區嘅游擊戰比正面決戰更重要，因此全場少有一役定勝負，長期係拉鋸式消耗。
tacticsEn: The terrain of Lazica dictated how both armies fought. The coastal road along the Black Sea ran from Petra, near modern Tsikhisdziri north of Batumi, to Phasis at Poti and then up into the Rioni valley and the mountains, a little over a hundred kilometres with fortresses chained along it; ridges, gorges and dense forest made it hard to deploy large formations and favoured the side on the ground. A Byzantine system of fortresses supplied by sea along that coast collided with a Persian system of cavalry and siege: the Persian army avoided storming heavily defended towns, concentrated on outer points such as Petra, and when a siege failed it turned to ravaging the villages, ruining the fields and cutting Roman recruitment and taxation; the Roman field army answered with the dense shield file that absorbed the cataphract charge, volleys from the archers in front, and then flank attacks by a small cavalry force to force the enemy to turn. The Armenian Vahan knew how to use the mountains and passes of Iberia, and his victory over Mihr-Mihroe in 551 rested on choosing the ground and striking unexpectedly; the Roman defeat at Anglon in 543 showed the danger of overconfident detachments operating in the hills, where Persian horse could envelop them. Winter mattered: the Persians usually attacked as the snows melted in spring, while the Romans held their towns through the rains on the strength of their sea supply; the Lazi and Tzani mountain levies knew the tracks and specialised in raiding Persian supply columns and outposts. On the whole both sides understood that the line of coastal fortresses and the harrying war in the hills mattered more than a pitched battle, which is why the campaign produced few decisive field actions and settled into a grinding contest of endurance.
data: 可核對嘅數字唔多，以下係史料與研究一般引述嘅量級。第一，戰爭由541年打到562年，足足二十一年，最終簽訂嘅係一份為期五十年的和約。第二，最終協議下，羅馬向波斯一次性支付約一萬一千鎊黃金，另加常年年費，一般記為每年八百鎊黃金，用以換取波斯撤出拉齊卡並承認拉齊卡為羅馬藩屬。第三，拉齊卡境內兩強先後據守過嘅堡壘多達十餘座，包括佩特拉、阿卡奧波利斯、薩拉帕尼斯、斯坎德、法西斯、羅多波利斯、烏基梅里翁、科塔雍、奧諾古里斯、特拉凱亞、塞巴斯托波利斯同皮提烏斯，其中三座係羅馬控制嘅海路據點。第四，帝國喺拉齊卡維持嘅常備與輔助部隊規模以數千計，色雷斯與阿蘭步兵、扎尼民兵同拉齊卡地方部隊編入禁軍同御林軍作戰，最前線另有約翰·齊布斯、多明努斯等分區指揮官各自率領數百至數千人作戰。第五，地理尺度上，由佩特拉到法西斯嘅沿岸公路約一百公里，由法西斯入里奧尼河谷至首都阿卡奧波利斯再有一日路程，山地縱深使波斯遠征軍每次都要分散成數支縱隊。第六，據普羅科匹烏斯《戰史》記載，541年佩特拉之圍、542年科斯勞親征時對佩特拉嘅圍城都因羅馬守軍死守城塞而未破，551年佩特拉一度淪陷，多明努斯與貝薩斯隨後收復。第七，人事上，約翰·齊布斯陣亡、瓦罕喺559年後因亞美尼亞王位糾紛同拜占庭反目返投波斯，說明雙方嘅結盟從來靠唔住。以上數字以概數為主，史料對冷兵器部隊嘅人數常有誇大之處。
dataEn: Verifiable figures are scarce, so what follows is the scale that the sources and modern studies generally give. First, the war ran from 541 to 562, a full twenty-one years, and it ended in a peace treaty of fifty years. Second, under the final terms Rome paid Persia about eleven thousand pounds of gold in a single payment, plus an annual subsidy generally recorded as eight hundred pounds of gold, in exchange for the Persian withdrawal from Lazica and the recognition of Lazica as a Roman vassal state. Third, more than a dozen fortresses were held in turn by the two powers inside Lazica, among them Petra, Archaeopolis, Sarapanis, Skande, Phasis, Rhodopolis, Uchimerion, Kotayon, Onoguris, Trachea, Sebastopolis and Pitius, three of them being the Roman maritime bases. Fourth, the Roman force maintained in Lazica numbered in the thousands: Thracian and Alan infantry, Tzani mountain levies and local Lazi units were folded into the scholae and the field army, while in the front line commanders such as John Tzibus and Domninus each led contingents of from several hundred to several thousand men. Fifth, in terms of distance, the coastal road from Petra to Phasis is about a hundred kilometres, and from Phasis up the Rioni valley to the capital Archaeopolis is another day's march, so the depth of the mountains forced every Persian expedition to split into several columns. Sixth, according to Procopius, the siege of Petra in 541 and Khosrow's personal siege of Petra in 542 both failed because the Roman garrison held the walls, while in 551 Petra fell for a time before Domninus and Bessas recovered it. Seventh, on personnel, the death of John Tzibus and Vahan's quarrel with Byzantium over the Armenian kingship, which turned him back to Persia after 559, show how unreliable the alliance had been. These numbers are magnitudes rather than exact counts; the sources habitually exaggerate the strength of cold-weapon formations.
cause: 拉齊克戰爭唔係因為仇恨而打嘅戰爭，而係一場關於商路、稅收同山口嘅計算。直接引爆點喺541年：拜占庭新任嘅亞美尼亞軍區軍事總監約翰·齊布斯為增加帝國收入而限制拉齊卡商人嘅自由貿易，抽緊本地貨物嘅徵收，鄉民同貴族怨聲載道；國王古巴澤二世權力被削，於是秘密向薩珊王科斯勞一世求援，將整個國家連同城塞交俾波斯人。深層原因有三：其一，拉齊卡控制黑海東岸通往裏海嘅山口群同伊比利亞通道，誰控制拉齊卡，誰就喺高加索多一個縱深，薩珊想由背後威脅拜占庭嘅亞美尼亞同黑海屬地；其二，拉齊卡係絲產區，羅馬帝國由此取得絲料供應宮廷同遠方貿易，薩珊朝廷亦一直想將呢條收入線攬入自己手裏；其三，當時高加索正處於三方角力——拜占庭、薩珊同嚈噠之間，阿拉美尼亞同伊比利亞兩邊都同羅馬結盟對付嚈噠，拉齊卡一旦落入薩珊手中，就等於喺嚈噠嘅西翼插上敵人，羅馬絕不能接受。宗教唔係主因但確有作用：波斯方面嘅祆教祭司隨軍傳教，試圖改變拉齊卡基督徒嘅信仰，令本地勢力更加不安。於是，一場商路同關稅嘅爭執，被放大成一場長達二十一年嘅帝國邊境戰爭。
causeEn: The Lazic War was not a war of hatred but a calculation about trade routes, taxation and mountain passes. The spark was in 541: John Tzibus, Byzantium's newly appointed magister militum per Armeniam, tightened restrictions on the free trade of Lazic merchants in order to raise the imperial revenue, squeezing the local goods and the customs, and the population and the nobility grew bitter. The king, Gubazes II, had been stripped of his powers, and so he secretly appealed to the Sasanian king Khosrow I and handed the whole country, with its fortresses, over to the Persians. Behind this lay three deeper causes. First, Lazica controlled the chain of passes that link the eastern Black Sea to the Caspian and the road through Iberia, so whoever held Lazica gained another line of depth in the Caucasus, and the Sasanians hoped to threaten Byzantine Armenia and the Black Sea provinces from the rear. Second, Lazica was a silk-producing region, from which the Roman empire drew raw silk for the court and for trade with the far east, and the Sasanian court had long wanted to pull that line of revenue into its own hands. Third, the Caucasus at that moment was a three-cornered contest between Byzantium, Persia and the Hephthalites; Armenia and Iberia were both allied to Rome against the Hephthalites, so a Lazica in Persian hands would plant an enemy on the Hephthalites' western flank, which Rome could not accept. Religion was not the main cause but it mattered: Zoroastrian priests travelled with the Persian army and tried to convert the Christian Lazi, adding to the unease of the local elite. In the end, a quarrel about trade and customs was magnified into a twenty-one-year war between two empires.
impact: 拉齊克戰爭嘅直接結果係拉齊卡免於被波斯直接吞併，但代價係羅馬要長期向波斯繳付年費，帝國東北方嘅邊防開支大增。戰爭亦改變咗高加索嘅權力結構：亞美尼亞系貴族瓦罕以羅馬盟友嘅身份喺伊比利亞擊敗波斯兵，等於喺薩珊側翼撕開一個口子，嚈噠失去伊比利亞同亞美尼亞兩個橋頭堡，之後更面對北方匈奴與突厥聯軍嘅壓力，嚈噠國家喺560年代崩潰，草原民族大舉西遷，日後衝擊歐洲同中東——一場發生喺黑海邊嘅邊境戰爭，成為歐亞大陸族群遷移鏈嘅一環。經濟上，薩珊朝廷喺拉齊卡方向得到更多絲路資源同黑海貿易嘅邊際利益，羅馬則要靠支付維持關係，兩國嘅絲價同外交地位都受影響。宗教上，拉齊卡嘅基督徒社群喺戰亂中保持咗信仰，拉齊卡王國作為獨立王國繼續存在，並成為後世喬治亞民族敘事中埃格里斯大戰嘅核心記憶；今喬治亞西部嘅拉齊卡地區仍保留多處拜占庭與薩珊時期嘅堡壘遺址。史料上，普羅科匹烏斯《戰史》第五至第八卷、阿加提亞《歷史》同喬治亞編年史，令呢場戰爭成為研究六世紀兵制、城防同絲路最豐富嘅史料之一。
impactEn: The immediate effect of the Lazic War was that Lazica escaped being swallowed outright by Persia, but the price was a long annuity paid by Rome to Persia and a heavy increase in the empire's north-eastern frontier costs. The war also reshaped the Caucasian balance of power: Vahan, an Armenian noble who fought as a Roman ally, defeated the Persians in Iberia and tore a gap in the Sasanian flank, while the Hephthalites lost their bridgeheads in Iberia and Armenia and then came under pressure from Huns and Turks in the north; the Hephthalite state collapsed in the 560s and the steppe peoples moved west in numbers, later striking at Europe and the Middle East. A frontier war fought on the shore of the Black Sea thus became one link in a Eurasian chain of migration. Economically, the Sasanian court gained more of the silk resource and the fringe benefits of Black Sea trade along the Lazican front, while Rome maintained the relationship by payment, and the price of silk and the standing of both empires in diplomacy were affected. Religiously, the Christian communities of Lazica kept their faith through the disorder, and the Lazic kingdom survived as a separate realm, becoming the core memory of the great war of Egrisi in later Georgian historiography; several Byzantine and Sasanian fortresses still stand in the Lazican region of modern western Georgia. Historically, the five books of Procopius, the continuation of Agathias, and the Georgian chronicles make this war one of the richest sources for the study of sixth-century military organisation, fortification and the silk routes.
result: 562年，五十年和約簽訂：薩珊方面放棄對拉齊卡嘅直接控制，承認拉齊卡為羅馬藩屬，羅馬則支付一次性金餅與常年年費；駐紮喺佩特拉、阿卡奧波利斯、法西斯同塞巴斯托波利斯等堡壘嘅羅馬守軍按約撤出，走前先拆毀城牆與防禦工事，免得變成波斯人接手嘅據點。拉齊卡王國保留原有君主同一定內政自主權，基督教信仰與教會組織未被波斯人改變，此後仍然向羅馬靠攏。軍事上，雙方都無決定性勝負：波斯未能長久控制拉齊卡，羅馬亦未能把拉齊卡變成直屬行省，二十一條年嘅消耗，加上羅馬同期要應付汪達爾、北非、意大利同高加索多線戰事，令帝國財政吃緊，比利基留嘅名聲亦喺呢段時間被消耗。真正嘅輸贏喺戰後仍然未見分曉——565年科斯勞一世死後，其子霍爾米茲二世曾企圖撕毀和約，567年波斯大軍西征直抵色雷斯，拉齊克和約隨即被新一輪戰爭取代，高加索前線再次回到長期消耗嘅老路。
resultEn: In 562 the fifty-year peace treaty was signed. Persia gave up direct control of Lazica and recognised it as a Roman vassal state, while Rome paid the lump sum and the annual subsidy. The Roman garrisons at Petra, Archaeopolis, Phasis, Sebastopolis and the other fortresses withdrew as the treaty required, and before leaving they dismantled walls and defences so that the Persians would not inherit usable positions. The Lazic kingdom kept its own king and a degree of internal autonomy, its Christian faith and church organisation were not altered by the Persians, and it stayed aligned with Rome afterwards. Militarily there was no decisive victory on either side: Persia did not hold Lazica for long, and Rome did not turn Lazica into a directly governed province. Twenty-one years of attrition, on top of Roman wars against the Vandals, in North Africa, in Italy and in the Caucasus, strained the imperial finances and consumed the reputation that Belisarius had earned. Who had really won was still unsettled after the fighting: Khosrow I died in 565, his son Hormizd II attempted to tear up the treaty, and in 567 a great Persian army marched west as far as Thrace, so that the Lazic peace was quickly replaced by a new war and the Caucasian front went back to its old pattern of long attrition.
